commentary: With Nifty tumbling 1.75% to 25,349 and breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 35, William O'Neil's market direction rule dictates that three out of four equities track the broader index under distribution. Stan Weinstein's discipline insists that even compelling breakouts face high failure rates when major indices violate key moving-average supports. The deterministic gate is WEAK; therefore, progressive exposure requires tight capital preservation, aggressive stop discipline, and strict avoidance of unconfirmed names. Only stocks demonstrating clear Stage 2 structural leadership and verified, accelerating CANSLIM earnings warrant close observation, while fixed-income ETFs and fundamental laggards must be pruned.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

AARTIPHARM.technical: Trading cleanly above rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA moving averages. Formed a constructive double bottom base with 1.15x volume expansion on the right side. RSI at 71 confirms strong relative strength against a declining general market, positioning it right at the 1048.30 pivot without being excessively extended.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Exhibits prime CANSLIM credentials with robust quarterly sales jumping 45.9% and operating leverage expanding EBITDA margin to 22.2%. Strong CDMO traction and xanthine derivative dominance support ROCE above 18%, offsetting modest working-capital debt expansion.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis invalidates if price breaks 963.13 stop support; cut loss immediately without hesitation.

ABDL.technical: Forming an emerging double bottom base with constructive lower wick rejections, holding above the 50-DMA and 200-DMA. However, volume confirmation remains muted, and overhead resistance near 855.55 requires further base maturity.
ABDL.fundamental: Single-digit top-line growth of 6.8% fails O'Neil's CANSLIM 15% revenue hurdle. While premiumization aids volumes, operating margins near 6.7% and moderate leverage limit earnings velocity, capping fundamental appeal.
ABDL.risk: Fails below the 798.53 swing pivot low, signaling base failure and distribution.

ABGSEC.technical: Trading within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above short-term moving averages with 1.87x volume expansion. However, as a government bond ETF, it lacks standard equity price discovery and Stage 2 structural expansion dynamics.
ABGSEC.risk: Violates structure if tracking below 116.48; sovereign debt vehicles lack equity earnings drivers.

AIROLAM.technical: Constructive double bottom with a classic three-higher-low sequence off the 21-EMA and 50-DMA. RSI at 55 exhibits healthy constructive accumulation without momentum exhaustion ahead of the 123.89 pivot level.
AIROLAM.fundamental: Laminate segment drove strong 30.8% YoY revenue growth and 55.5% EPS surge in Q2 FY27. Operating margin recovered toward 8.4%, though financial leverage and modest historic ROCE require careful balance sheet tracking.
AIROLAM.risk: Breach of 103.64 invalidates the base structure and warrants immediate exit.

AJAXENGG.technical: Firmly positioned in Stage 2 above rising EMA21, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA. Developing a solid double bottom base with 1.56x volume and bullish MACD confirmation, threatening a pivot breakout toward 635.63.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: Dominant concrete machinery manufacturer with 75.5% SLCM market share, zero net debt, and healthy 23.9% ROCE. Net profit surged 30% in Q2 FY27, though sub-10% revenue growth limits full CANSLIM qualification.
AJAXENGG.risk: Thesis breaks below the 594.18 swing stop; raw material margin pressure poses risk.

AJMERA.technical: Breakout past 20-session highs on massive 28.87x relative volume expansion, trading above all key moving averages. However, huge single-day volume bursts carry near-term exhaustion and pullback risk in a declining general market.
AJMERA.fundamental: Q2 FY27 sales grew 62.9% YoY on solid residential project pre-sales, generating a 27% operating profit margin. However, net profit growth of 21.3% trails the 25% CANSLIM threshold, and debt-to-equity stands at 0.55x.
AJMERA.risk: Failure to hold the 135.25 support triggers a severe failed breakout pattern.
